name: Murcia
shape: Eurostat NUTS, the area it is named for

climate: A dry climate, with little rain while the vines grow. Water is scarce and the dry air keeps disease down.

blurb.text: A Spanish PGI in the Vino de la Tierra (IGP) category, covering Murcia, where Monastrell dominates, making up 76 percent of plantings. Alicante Bouschet is second at 7 percent, followed by Syrah, Airén and Tempranillo at 3 percent each.
